what_lands: Umbrella Amendment R's first three rulings, performed, one per commit. Ruling 1: survival.pricing gains the basic-attack swing composition -- the deterministic crit blend and Warden's Mail's capped flat subtraction, transported on the declaration, with the plating multiplier and the target's crit-damage multiplier folded into the declared magnitudes because a pure factor on a linear mitigation prices to the same real number. Ruling 2: Amendment N, Ruling 2's term census widens from post-authoring packet mutation to authoring-time mitigation terms, derived from the same syntax tree, with its R-05 negative updated to an injected authoring-time term. Ruling 3: a routing family re-delivers a source family's declared magnitude composed with its own damage_share, attributed under D-62 at the secondary subject with the routing recorded in provenance, and declares no magnitude of its own. Ruling 4 is not performed here and needs nothing from this slice: it landed as its own act (campaign-close-swing-term-coverage), and the roster it added is what makes this slice's armed equivalence fixtures measurable at all.

landed_against.rule: R-17/R-32/D-97 -- no baseline moves inside any semantic commit of this slice group. The code lands against the committed baselines; a re-capture, if the measurement ever asks for one, is the integration agent's own commit.

qualifying_population.rule: R-20's second half. The count is not knowable by inspection the way the resistance term's was, and the reason is the campaign's own progress: eight families have now retired, so the tree DOES author packets carrying a declaration, and every one of them is a packet this slice group's code reaches. The population is therefore enumerated from committed artifacts before the group's first src/ edit, and it is the packets that carry a declaration -- the one route by which any of this code can move a number.
qualifying_population.method: Every committed coupled scenario in scripts/golden_snapshot.COUPLED_SCENARIOS, resolved and run through calculator.pipeline.run_fight for each of its target fights, counting the authored damage events that carry a `declared` field and recording the WIDTH of each declaration -- because the width is what decides whether this group's terms reach it. Re-run against the stashed pre-edit tree and against the working tree, with identical results, so the enumeration is a fact about the tree the slice starts from rather than about the tree it produces.
qualifying_population.every_declaration_is_four_wide_and_that_: All 88 carry the four facts Amendment N, Ruling 1 left the declaration at -- rule, magnitude, attack class, effective resistance -- and none carries a fifth. Ruling 1's swing composition is the fifth position, so `AuthoredDeclaration.swing_composition()` returns None for every packet the tree authors and `price_declared_packet` takes the branch it took before the term existed. That is measured rather than argued, and it is what makes the R-20 line a prediction instead of a hope: the term is armed for whatever a retiring family hands it and reaches nothing today.
qualifying_population.the_thing_the_terms_are_ABOUT_is_not_emp: A population of 88 declarations none of which is a swing only means something beside a non-zero population of the delivery the term describes. The same enumeration finds 19 basic-attack-swing-delivered rows across 14 of the 20 scenarios, and 4 rows authored by the routing family across 2 of them -- crit_onhit_carry_roster and swing_term_armed_carry_roster each publish Runaan's bolt row and its copied on-hit row. So both of this group's new terms have something in the committed baselines to be wrong about, and neither is armed by anything.

pair_engine_population.why: scripts/golden_baseline.json is the one-attacker pair-engine surface, and it records each build's sorted breakdown_keys and its total_damage. This slice group adds no pair-engine arithmetic: Ruling 1 and Ruling 3 edit src/calculator/survival/pricing.py, src/calculator/survival/transitions.py and src/calculator/program/compile.py -- all walk-side -- and Ruling 2 edits scripts/term_census.py, which the calculator never imports. src/calculator/damage.py is read by the census and written by nobody here. No key is added or removed and no total moves, so zero is a declared population rather than an observation and a single diff there stops the group.

qualifying_population.predicted: 0 occurrences on both compared baselines, bounded by the 88 declarations above. Every one of them is priced through the same two terms it was priced through before this group, because the third term is reached only by a declaration that carries a swing composition and no authoring site stamps one; and the routing path is reached only by a packet a router built, and no interpreter builds one. Any occurrence at all is therefore outside the population and stops the slice.

measured_after.what_moved_that_is_not_a_number: The declaration's WIDTH, on every packet the tree authors. AuthoredDeclaration gained a fifth position for Ruling 1's swing composition, so the 88 four-wide declarations the population enumerated are five-wide after a7e08e7 with None in the fifth. Nothing serializes that field -- it is absent from both committed baselines, checked before the edit -- and swing_composition() returns None for every one of them, so price_declared_packet takes the branch it took before the position existed. Two pinned event dicts in tests/test_eclipse_timeline.py spell the tuple literally and were updated in the same commit; that is the whole of the visible change and it is a width rather than a value. Recorded here rather than left to a reader, because a shape change on every packet in the model is exactly the kind of thing a green gate can carry in silence.
measured_after.the_census_widened_and_found_nothing_unc: Nine authoring-time mitigation terms, zero uncovered, on the instrument's first clean run over this tree -- which is a DIFFERENT result from Amendment N's widening, where _resolve_starting_shield_outcome came back UNCOVERED, and it is reported as the result it is rather than as a target that was aimed at. The two resistances are covered by DeclaredPacket.effective_resistance, the three holder-amp reads by DeclaredPacket.holder_amp, the plating multiplier and the target's crit-damage multiplier fold into the declared magnitude, and Warden's Mail's flat and its cap are transported by the two BasicAttackSwing fields named after them. No exclusion was written by this group and none was needed; a ruled, dated exclusion is the umbrella's to record and not a lane's.
